findings.detail: Affiliated-investment rollforward ending fair values of 246,700,365 and 109,219,052 were added again; their 355,919,417 sum exactly equals the excess over the 657,323,982 schedule total.

rationale: The filing schedule reports Total Debt & Equity Investments fair value of 657,323,982, while extracted holdings sum to 1,013,243,399. The excess is 355,919,417, exactly equal to the controlled and non-controlled affiliated rollforward ending fair values of 246,700,365 plus 109,219,052. Those rollforward amounts duplicate investments already represented in the schedule, proving a dimension/section double count rather than a bad filing anchor.
